high.title: Stock Market Liquidity "Disappears" Ahead of World Cup
high.summary: The Vietnamese stock market experienced another grim trading session with liquidity hitting rock bottom. Trading value on HoSE plummeted 49% from the previous session to just VND 10.133 trillion. On the matching orders channel alone, value was only VND 9.3 trillion, down 14% from the previous session. This marks the lowest liquidity level in 14 months since the historic rally after the "tariff storm" on April 10, 2025. The average June 2026 matching order value on HoSE has dropped to just over VND 13 trillion per session, falling 37% compared to May's average. This represents the weakest money flow since January 2025. The dramatic liquidity decline suggests risk-off sentiment among investors, potentially reflecting broader concerns about market conditions and economic uncertainties. This trend is particularly concerning for fund managers as it indicates reduced market participation and could signal further volatility ahead.

high.title: Expert: Gold Price Decline Causes People to Sell More Than Buy, Helping Support Exchange Rate
high.summary: Speaking at the Vietnam Investment Forum 2026 Summer Summit, Mr. Nguyen Xuan Thanh from Fulbright School of Public Policy noted that external shocks are changing interest rate adjustment trajectories of major economies, especially the US. The US economy continues showing strong resilience with non-farm payrolls consistently beating forecasts while inflation has maintained around 4.3% for three consecutive months. The Fed's current view is that there's no urgent need to worry about the labor market this year, reducing pressure for downward rate adjustments. Regarding gold prices, the expert observed that declining gold prices are causing Vietnamese citizens to sell more than buy, which helps support the VND exchange rate by reducing demand for foreign currency. This dynamic represents a positive development for Vietnam's FX stability as lower gold prices reduce dollarization pressures in the domestic economy.

high.title: State Bank of Vietnam Advises Citizens When Buying Gold
high.summary: The State Bank of Vietnam, as the government's representative agency for unified state management of gold trading activities, has continuously improved the legal framework and enhanced management effectiveness in the gold market. The SBV has systematically implemented solutions to complete regulations, with the legal framework for gold trading management constantly being refined. Government Decree No. 24/2012/ND-CP on gold trading management was issued to strengthen state management efficiency in the gold market, contributing to macroeconomic stability and ensuring financial and monetary system safety while limiting "gold-ization" in the economy. This was followed by Decree No. 232/2025/ND-CP amending certain provisions to further improve gold trading management mechanisms. The SBV's guidance comes amid volatile gold prices and aims to protect consumers while maintaining market stability through proper regulatory oversight.

medium.title: Gold Ring and Gold Bar Prices Evening 11/6 Surge After Morning Plunge
medium.summary: Domestic gold prices recovered strongly after morning declines, with SJC gold bars closing at VND 133.4-138.4 million per tael, up VND 100,000 on both buy and sell sides. Various gold companies showed mixed movements but generally recovered from earlier losses, indicating volatile but stabilizing market conditions.

medium.title: Au Lac Group Increases ACB Ownership Above 8%
medium.summary: Asia Commercial Bank (ACB) recorded significant ownership changes from the group related to Mr. Nguyen Duc Hieu Johnny and Ms. Ngo Thu Thuy. Mr. Johnny purchased an additional 1.95 million ACB shares on June 5, 2026, increasing his stake from 1.86% to 1.90%. Combined with related parties, the total group ownership now exceeds 8%.

medium.title: Savings Interest Rates on June 10 at Agribank, Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, MB, Sacombank, HDBank
medium.summary: Survey of 34 domestic banks shows 12-month online deposit rates ranging from 3.7% to 7% annually. The Big4 state banks maintain unified rates with 12-month deposits at 6.8% annually. MBV, PGBank and VIB lead with 7% rates for certain terms, showing continued rate stability across the banking sector.

medium.title: What's Happening with SJC Gold Bars and Gold Rings?
medium.summary: On June 10, SJC and other gold companies simultaneously reduced gold prices sharply. SJC gold bars fell to VND 135-140 million per tael, down VND 3.8 million from the previous day - the lowest since October last year. Investors who bought at peaks are facing significant losses, with some losing VND 135 million on 3 taels purchased during peak prices.

medium.title: Gold Ring and Gold Bar Prices Evening 12/6 Rise to Weekly High
medium.summary: Gold prices recovered to weekly highs, with companies raising prices by VND 6.7-9.1 million per tael, bringing gold bars back above VND 145 million per tael. SJC quoted gold rings at VND 142.3-145.3 million per tael, while DOJI maintained the highest market rates, showing continued volatility in domestic gold markets.

medium.title: Savings Interest Rates on June 12 at Agribank, Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, MB, Sacombank, HDBank
medium.summary: Interest rate survey shows continued stability with Big4 banks maintaining 6.8% annually for 12-month terms. MBV and VCBNeo lead with 7% rates for longer terms. The rate environment remains stable with minimal changes across the banking sector.

medium.title: Payment Security: "Race Without Finish Line" for Banking Industry
medium.summary: Vietnam Banking Association held the 2026 Payment Risk Management Conference on "Payment Security in Digital Era: Opportunities and Challenges." Payment security has become a strategic mission requiring continuous infrastructure investment, technology upgrades, and enhanced human resources to protect banking systems and maintain market confidence.
